## What changed?

Describe the document(s) added, updated, linked, deprecated, or removed.

## Change type

- [ ] New document
- [ ] Improve existing document
- [ ] Correct outdated or inaccurate content
- [ ] Link/restructure existing knowledge
- [ ] Governance or repository change

## Duplication check

- [ ] I searched the existing library before creating new content.
- [ ] This change updates or links canonical documents instead of duplicating existing instructions.

## Document quality

- [ ] Document type is correct.
- [ ] Required frontmatter is present and accurate.
- [ ] Related documents are linked where useful.
- [ ] The operational owner is identified.
- [ ] No sensitive credentials or secrets are included.

## Reviewer notes

Anything the SOP approver should pay special attention to?
